decisions.decision: Centralized formatter lives in a new internal/gateway/handlers/format.go collecting the existing commaGroup/formatMoney/formatKm/formatKmRaw helpers; no new exported package
decisions.why: formatMoney already existed but was buried in supercharger.go, which is why charges.go never found it; same-package move keeps every call site compiling and adds no indirection

decisions.decision: Money format is locale-invariant 1,234.56 for both ES and EN; formatMoney stays a pure function with no context.Context
decisions.why: Ticket asks for it explicitly for ALL currency values; keeps money consistent with the already locale-invariant formatKm; one testable code path. Deliberate deviation from es-CO convention

decisions.decision: Scope is monetary values only; kWh/km/degC/pct untouched. kWh-vs-km grouping inconsistency recorded as backlog item 9
decisions.why: Ticket asked for currency only; widening would break existing exact-string assertions and expand the reviewed blast radius

decisions.decision: Add a grep-based money-guard Makefile target wired into check, mirroring ui-guard/i18n-guard
decisions.why: The bug existed because formatMoney was available but nothing forced its use; a deterministic CI signal beats a doc note or per-site tests for catching future pages

decisions.decision: Unit tests INCLUDED: table-driven TestFormatMoney plus one assertion per fixed site and a negative test for the Raw* fields
decisions.why: User's standing default is no tests, but formatMoney is a pure function with a near-zero-cost test surface; asked and answered explicitly

decisions.decision: Leader corrected the tasks.md header note, whose A-G letter mapping had drifted from the A-F body (it labelled B as C and referenced a nonexistent task G)
decisions.why: Header contradicted the body's dependency graph; a cheap leader fix now beats a review-round finding later

decisions.decision: Batched B/C/D/E (14 tasks spanning 3 dependency waves) into ONE serial worker dispatch instead of three separate waves; A kept as its own prior dispatch
decisions.why: All 14 are tiny same-module edits; a serial worker executing in dependency order satisfies the graph while reading the doc pack once instead of three times. A stays separate so a compile-clean baseline exists before any call site changes
